result_text:
I changed the per-rep purchase order count so it leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The change is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6518). The inner purchase order subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the per-quarter report uses. Reps with no remaining purchase orders still come back with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

`mvn -q -o test` for `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` and `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest` passed with no output. I did not add a test case for a cancelled order, so the new filter isn't covered by a test yet.

`findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry` has the same gap: it still counts cancelled purchase orders. I left it alone because the task only covers the per-rep report. Say if you want it changed too.

Nothing is committed.
